fm.title: Intel soc
fm.description: Processor-FPGA communication and task management on Intel SoC (5 blocks)

rows.intent: Read data from FPGA fabric via AXI4 interface on Intel SoC — use for processor-to-FPGA data transfer in Intel Cyclone/Arria SoC designs
Write data to FPGA fabric via AXI4 interface on Intel SoC — use for processor-to-FPGA command or data passing in Intel SoC designs
Configure a Linux task for execution on Intel SoC ARM core — use for scheduling generated code as a Linux process on the HPS
Receive UDP packets on Intel SoC Linux — use for network data input to algorithms running on Intel SoC embedded Linux
Send UDP packets from Intel SoC Linux — use for network data output from algorithms running on Intel SoC embedded Linux
